ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white to 25% low-intensity black pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on left and right lobes. Black perimeter border along leading and trailing edges. Central black vertical band at the peduncle junction. Scattered small black spots and one prominent black line on the lower-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 65 degrees and significant depth extending toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the distal margins. Prominent high-amplitude notches located medially on both lobes near the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature from the median notch extending out to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Large clusters of brownish-tan high-contrast pixels located at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with epibiotic colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct, thick black linear segment oriented diagonally on the lower-left lobe surface. Several smaller faint dark horizontal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations on both fluke tips. Multiple small, dark, circular punctate marks/scars scattered across the white ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish epibiotic clusters (barnacles/cyamids) localized on the trailing edge tips.
